feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 4 September 2026 11:50am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 04 September 2026 at 11:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the northwest of Scotland as a frontal wave continues to clear the south of the British Isles.


##Wind##

West or southwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the east, decreasing west 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, only isolated showers developing for a time in the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 4, soon backing south or southwest 3 or 4, then south 4 or 5 Saturday evening. Increasing 5 or 6 overnight into Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Slight becoming moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair, then occasional rain overnight into Sunday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain.
